housing-numbers.notes: Total requirement of 8800 dwellings for 2003-2025 period (400 per annum). 1305 dwellings built between 2003-2009. Specific allocations to be determined in separate Allocations of Land DPD. Trajectory shows phased delivery across settlement hierarchy with Kendal (35% share), Ulverston (20% share), Key Service Centres (13% share), Local Service Centres (21% share), and Other Areas (11% share).
